subject.title: feat(feishu): pass through form_value, input_value, option(s) from card actions

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu card-action callbacks use when form/input/select fields are present alongside action.value?
rationale: The missing data path is source-proven, but structured JSON versus command-preserving text affects downstream agent command parsing and compatibility for existing Feishu card workflows.

options.title: Command-compatible structured fix
options.body: Carry the fields through the parser and expose them without replacing existing text/command extraction unless no command/text value exists.

options.title: JSON-only form payload
options.body: Accept the PR's JSON text shape for callbacks with form/select metadata and own the compatibility impact for command-bearing callbacks.

options.title: Pause for broader card contract
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers define one payload contract across direct interactive cards, card-action callbacks, and related Feishu card parsing issues.

recommendation.title: Command-compatible structured fix
recommendation.body: Carry the fields through the parser and expose them without replacing existing text/command extraction unless no command/text value exists.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest current-code and recent-history signal on the Feishu card-action parser/handler paths that need the decision applied.
